name: browser-control-firefox
description: Cowork with an AI agent in Mozilla Firefox: tabs, tab groups, bookmarks, history, page content and interaction, within an access policy you control
long_description:
This MCP server lets an AI assistant work in your Firefox browser alongside you: organize tabs and tab groups, archive research into bookmarks, follow what changed since it last looked, read pages and your selection, and interact with pages you allow.

Everything is governed by an access policy you write in the Firefox add-on's settings (for example: let it shop freely on one store, never even see your bank, keep a tab group private). A pause switch in the toolbar stops the agent instantly.

**Note:** This requires the matching Browser Control MCP Firefox add-on (version 2.0 or later). Install the add-on, then copy the secret key from its settings page into this extension's configuration.
